name: Apple Podcasts
why_listed: iPhone listeners who only need transcripts and timestamp sharing would stay in the built-in Apple Podcasts app instead of adopting Spoken Margins.

platforms.value: iOS, iPadOS, macOS, watchOS, tvOS, visionOS, CarPlay, web (podcasts.apple.com)
platforms.detail: Preinstalled on Apple devices and available on the web.

voice_notes_anchored.note: Judged from Apple's product page for Apple Podcasts, which is the vendor's feature overview and lists no such feature. The iPhone transcript guide offers play, share and select text only.

text_notes_anchored.detail: No notes, but selected transcript text (up to 200 words) can be shared to Notes or another app with its timestamp.

sources.title: View podcast transcripts on iPhone - Apple Support
sources.quote: Select text, then choose to play from that point, copy text, or share from that point.

sources.title: Share podcasts on Mac - Apple Support
sources.quote: Control-click the text, then choose 'Share from [timestamp].'

text_notes_anchored.note: The note lives in the other app (e.g. Apple Notes), not in Podcasts. The 200-word limit is from the Mac guide as summarised by WebFetch.

hands_free_capture.detail: No capture of moments by headphone gesture, Watch or CarPlay.
